summary: Creates or modifies SOP geometry from CHOP channels, mapping samples into points, polygons, normals, and custom point attributes.

key_params.name: organize
key_params.note: How samples are organized into geometry

common_gotchas: Named tx, ty, and tz channels map naturally to point positions; missing position channels fall back to the generated line and warn.
The default generated shape is a line from -1 to 1 with one point per CHOP sample.
Custom attributes created from CHOPs are float attributes of size 1 unless mapped otherwise.
Resampling changes sample-to-point correspondence compared with one-to-one mapping.
key_concepts: CHOP to SOP converts CHOP samples into SOP point positions and attributes.
Without an input SOP, the default generated geometry is a line from -1 to 1 with one point per CHOP sample.
Channels named tx, ty, and tz map naturally to P position components.
Channel scope, attribute scope, and mapping mode control whether samples map one-to-one or are resampled onto geometry.
